properties.displayName: Redis geo replication unhealthy for 60 complete minutes
properties.description: Missing samples prevent the sustained-unhealthy test, rather than counting as healthy or unhealthy.

allOf.query:
[replace('            let endTime = bin(now(), 1m);
            let startTime = endTime - 60m;
            let targets = dynamic(__TARGETS__);
            AzureMetrics
            | where TimeGenerated >= startTime and TimeGenerated < endTime
            | where tolower(_ResourceId) in (targets)
            | where MetricName =~ "geoReplicationHealthy"
            | where isnotnull(Maximum)
            | summarize Health=max(Maximum) by _ResourceId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
            | summarize Samples=count(), MaxHealth=max(Health) by _ResourceId
            | where Samples == 60 and MaxHealth == 0
            ', '__TARGETS__', string(map(parameters('redisIds'), lambda('id', toLower(lambdaVariables('id'))))))]
